commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.learned_history_observability_probe --env-config configs/m91c_raw_wheel_minimum_profile.json --episodes 40 --seed 9360 --policy heuristic --horizon-steps 15 --sample-stride 3 --max-samples 1000 --history-window 50 --device cpu --epochs 80 --run-dir runs/m91g_learned_history_encoder_seed9360
commands.name: learned_history_encoder_observability_probe

decision_rule: Use a supervised learned history encoder to test whether command-response history contains predictive belief information that linear probes miss.
failure_criteria: learned probe cannot beat the current-frame ridge baseline on any target
results are interpreted as a promoted control policy
hypothesis: A small supervised GRU or temporal MLP over past command-response frames can extract self-ID information better than raw concatenation or hand summaries.
success_criteria: learned history encoder runs without PPO
episode-disjoint test metrics are reported for P0 and P1
P1 learned history improves at least one target over P1 current-frame ridge
decision states whether to proceed to sensor ablations or corpus redesign
